svg.text: Fixed exposure coverage · exposure-separated query evidence · per-object sparse routing · one DETR prediction set

g.text: Router inputs for every query–exposure pair
query state + exposure evidence + stop embedding

svg.text: Frozen DETR weights remain unchanged; only six layers of routing projections and the stop encoder are trainable.
